business.description: Nikki Global Finance Limited is engaged in Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) activities.

products.name: Diversified debt products

outlook.statement: Focus remains firmly on building a stronger and more resilient organization, backed by a well-defined roadmap and unwavering support of stakeholders, approaching the coming year with confidence to sustain positive momentum.

The Company enters FY 2026-27 with renewed confidence, prioritising stronger underwriting standards, deeper digital integration, and more robust recovery mechanisms. The year ahead will see the Company build on this momentum, growing its loan book cautiously, sharpening asset quality, and working purposefully to sustain and deepen profitability.
